# gh-1106: SM: fork silent-update must escalate token on 'workflows' permission rejection instead of guest-parking

## Description

## Goal — fork silent-update survives `workflows`-permission rejection (v1)
One sentence: **an approved fork PR whose update-from-main touches `.github/workflows/*` gets its branch updated and merged by the SM instead of parking guest-style forever.**

Today the SM's fork silent-update (`js/smAgent.js` ~2380–2440) pushes the `main` merge into the fork head with `silentToken` (= the caller's `github.token`, `github-actions[bot]`). `GITHUB_TOKEN` can never create/update workflow files (no `workflows` permission exists for it, `permissions:` cannot grant it). As soon as `main` has a workflow-file change the fork branch lacks, every push is rejected, `recordForkSilentUpdateFailure` counts it as "maintainer edits revoked", and after 3 ticks the PR is parked guest-style with `validation_failed`, which then holds because "the head predates the park event (no new push since)". Deadlock: no push → park holds → no push.

Live case: IstiN/flutter_agent_harness#1591 (fork `YuryBY`, `maintainerCanModify=true`, APPROVED, BEHIND), ticks 2026-10-19 17:16/17:17:
```
! [remote rejected] HEAD -> fix/android-dap-home-sandbox (refusing to allow a GitHub App to create or update workflow `.github/workflows/build-mobile.yml` without `workflows` permission)
❌ pr-1591 fork silent-update parked guest-style after 3 consecutive push failures (gh-1070 AC3)
🅿️ pr-1591 validation_failed holds — the head predates the park event (no new push since)
```

## Why this framing
- Retracted: "maintainer edits were revoked" — the misdiagnosis gh-1070 AC3 applies to *every* push failure. This rejection is a token-capability fact, not an author decision, and it is deterministic (retrying with the same token can never succeed).
- Retracted: fixing in workflow YAML. `machine-sm.yml` / `factory-sm.yml` already deliver both `silentToken` and `sourceToken`; the decision belongs to the engine.

## Architecture
Subject of every action = **the fork PR head branch** (`head.repo.full_name`:`head.ref`), never the base repo.

```
silent push (silentToken) ──ok──▶ done (no CI event, as today)
        │ rejected
        ▼ classify stderr tail
  workflows-permission? ──no──▶ existing gh-1070 AC3 trail (unchanged)
        │ yes
        ▼
  escalated push (sourceToken: App installation token or PAT) ──ok──▶ head moved;
        │                                                      CI fires normally (acceptable: head changed, revalidation is required anyway)
        │ rejected (escalation token also lacks workflow write)
        ▼
  park with a DISTINCT reason "update needs workflow-write token" (actionable, not "edits revoked"); not counted toward the 3-strike trail
```
Invariants:
- Same token-in-env pattern as today: `forkPushTokenUrl` keeps `${GH_TOKEN}` in the URL; the escalation only swaps env `GH_TOKEN` and restores it in `finally`. The token never appears in script source or logs.
- Classifier is a pure function `isWorkflowsPermissionRejection(stderrTail)` in `js/common/validationLiveness.js` (matches `refusing to allow a GitHub App to create or update workflow` and `refusing to allow an OAuth App ... without \`workflow\` scope`).
- One escalated attempt per PR per tick.
- The same classification + escalation applies to the non-fork path `_ghSilentUpdateBranch` (`js/common/smProvider.js` ~839) for base-repo branches.
- A `validation_failed` park created by a workflows-permission rejection is lifted when the escalated push moves the head (the head now post-dates the park).

## Capability surface (tokens available to the tick)
| Token | Source | Workflow-file write | Push fires CI | Use |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `silentToken` | `github.token` | **never** (platform fact) | no | default silent update (core, unchanged) |
| App installation token | `create-github-app-token` (APP_ID/APP_PRIVATE_KEY) | only if App has *Workflows: write* | yes | escalation (core) |
| `SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN` PAT | secret | only with `workflow` scope | yes | escalation fallback when no App (core) |
Excluded: requesting permissions at runtime (impossible); rewriting the merge to skip workflow files (corrupts the branch).

Pinned platform facts (each with +/- test via stderr fixtures): `GITHUB_TOKEN` push touching `.github/workflows/**` is rejected; same push with workflow-capable token succeeds; push not touching workflows succeeds with `GITHUB_TOKEN`.

## Security
- Escalation token is a write token to a **fork** owned by a third party, used only under `maintainerCanModify=true` (existing gate, unchanged).
- Never log the token; stderr tail stays redacted (existing redaction).
- Escalation pushes only the SM-built merge commit of `main` into head — no author content is executed before the push.

## Acceptance criteria
- **AC1** — workflows-permission rejection with `silentToken` triggers exactly one escalated push with `sourceToken` in the same tick (UT-1, IT-1).
- **AC2** — that rejection does **not** increment the gh-1070 failure trail and does not park guest-style (UT-2).
- **AC3** — if escalation also fails with the same class, the PR parks with a distinct reason/marker naming the missing token capability (UT-3).
- **AC4** — after a successful escalated push the `validation_failed` hold is released by the existing "new push since park" rule and CI is dispatched (IT-2).
- **AC5** — non-workflows rejections keep today's behavior byte-identical (REG-1).
- **AC6** — same behavior on the base-repo path `_ghSilentUpdateBranch` (UT-4).
- **AC7** — `GH_TOKEN` env is restored after escalation even on exception (UT-5).

## Test plan
- `UT-1..5` in `js/unit-tests` with stderr fixtures (the exact #1591 line + OAuth-scope variant + unrelated rejection).
- `IT-1/2` SM tick harness with stubbed `cli_execute_command`: first push rejected → second with swapped env succeeds → head moves.
- `REG-1` existing gh-1070 / gh-1074 fork tests unchanged and green.
- Red REG blocks merge even if UT/IT are green.

### Edge cases
- **E1** — no App and PAT lacks `workflow` scope → AC3 park, one marker, no infinite retries.
- **E2** — author disables maintainer edits mid-flight → old gh-1070 path (different stderr).
- **E3** — dry-run: logs the planned escalation, no push.
- **E4** — stderr truncated before the marker phrase → treated as generic (safe default).

## Non-goals
- Changing tokens wired in `machine-sm.yml` / `factory-sm.yml`.
- Auto-unparking PRs parked by genuine maintainer-edit revocation.

## Open questions
- Does the fa App have *Workflows: write*? If not: grant it, or rely on PAT `workflow` scope.

## References
- IstiN/flutter_agent_harness#1591; gh-1070 AC3, gh-1074 (fork silent-update trail); #687 (silent token); awf#52 (App token).

## Machine jobs
- [x] ▶ dev (fa-story-dev) · [run](https://github.com/IstiN/dmtools-agents/actions/runs/39295751389) · started 17:38 · done 18:18 ✅

All required context — ticket description, PR diff, CI status, and related materials — has already been prepared in the `input/` folder. Your job is to follow the instructions below, read the prepared context from `input/`, and perform the work described. Do not ask for identifiers; the context is already available locally. ```mermaid flowchart TD G1["⚠️ Review Guidelines — evaluate against existing codebase patterns"] G2["Before reviewing, explore the project's code structure, architecture, and testing patterns"] G3["If AGENTS.md exists → READ it — defines coding styles to check against"] G4["Flag deviations from established patterns unless justified in PR description"] G1 --> G2 --> G3 --> G4 ``` # PR Review General Guidelines ## Review flow ```mermaid flowchart TD START([PR ready for review]) --> READ["1. pr_review.json · pr_review_general.md · pr_review_comments/*.md"] OUTPUT --> END([End]) ``` ## 1. Input context — MANDATORY reading order ```mermaid flowchart TD subgraph PR_CONTEXT["⚠️ PR-specific files (read first)"] P1["1️⃣ instruction.md (repo root) — project stack, conventions"] P2["2️⃣ input/TICKET/pr_info.md — PR title, author, branch, description"] P3["3️⃣ input/TICKET/pr_diff.txt — the diff to review"] P4["4️⃣ input/TICKET/pr_files.txt — list of changed files"] P5["5️⃣ input/TICKET/ci_failures.md — CI failures = BLOCKING (last 500 lines)"] P5_FULL["5️⃣ input/TICKET/ci_failures_full.log — full CI logs"] P6["6️⃣ input/TICKET/pr_discussions.md + pr_discussions_raw.json — existing comments"] P1 --> P2 --> P3 --> P4 --> P5 --> P5_FULL --> P6 end subgraph TICKET_CONTEXT["Ticket context (for understanding PR purpose)"] T1["7️⃣ input/TICKET/ticket.md — linked ticket description, ACs"] T2["8️⃣ input/TICKET/comments.md — ticket discussion if present"] T3["9️⃣ input/TICKET/parent-*.md — parent story context"] T4["🔟 input/TICKET/confluence/*.md — linked specifications"] T1 --> T2 --> T3 --> T4 end subgraph RULE["⚠️ Rule"] R1["If file exists in input/ → read locally, do NOT re-fetch via dmtools"] end PR_CONTEXT --> TICKET_CONTEXT --> RULE ``` Read PR files to understand WHAT changed. Read ticket files to understand WHY it changed and verify against requirements. ## 2. Diff checklist — apply to `pr_diff.txt` For every hunk, ask at least these questions: - [ ] Does the change match the ticket scope? Any scope creep? - [ ] Are new or changed public APIs contract-safe for existing callers? - [ ] Is user/external input validated, sanitized, or escaped? - [ ] Are secrets, tokens, or PATs handled safely — not logged, not interpolated into shell scripts? - [ ] Are new or modified files present under `testing/` in a non-test-automation PR? - [ ] Is dead code, unused imports, or obvious duplication introduced? - [ ] Are error paths handled, or are failures silently swallowed? - [ ] Are new dependencies justified and compatible with the existing stack? - [ ] Beyond blockers: what other maintainability, correctness, or quality improvements are visible in the changed code? ## 3. Changed-file deep read Do not review from the diff alone. Read the full content of every changed file: - imports and dependencies - class/method responsibilities and adherence to SRP / OOP principles - naming consistency with the rest of the codebase - error handling, logging, and edge cases - test coverage for changed behavior - backward-compatibility and migration impact ## 4. Impact analysis (CodeGraph or grep fallback) Use CodeGraph to find "what could break": - `codegraph_callers` / `codegraph_callees` on modified public symbols - `codegraph_search` for: `PAT_TOKEN`, `secrets.`, `github.token`, `previousViewModel` - `codegraph_impact` before flagging architectural changes **If CodeGraph unavailable**, use grep and document it: ```bash grep -rn "changedFunctionName" --include="*.ts" . grep -rn "secrets\.\|github\.token" . ``` ## 5. Must be fixed. - **IMPORTANT** — real maintainability or correctness issue. Strongly prefer fixing before merge. - **SUGGESTION** — optional improvement, style, or future polish. Does not block merge. When in doubt, start one level higher; downgrade only after confirming the risk is negligible. ### External-spec evidence rule A finding whose core claim is "**the spec / reference / ticket / external tool says or does X**" may be raised at 🚨 **BLOCKING** only when it quotes the exact source the review actually read during this run — a `file:line` reference or a doc URL. A bare "the spec says …" assertion is unfalsifiable for the author and for the machine, and a false one holds a validated PR hostage (live: a BLOCKING thread claiming an exemption list that the reference source did not contain — the reviewed code was behaviorally identical to it). Without a verifiable citation: - Downgrade the finding to ⚠️ **IMPORTANT**, phrased as a question: "Please confirm against `` — if confirmed, this becomes blocking." - Never let an uncited spec assertion be the sole reason for `REQUEST_CHANGES`. This is not a strictness cut: a spec-claim finding **with** a verifiable citation keeps full 🚨 BLOCKING force. ## 7. Exhaustive single-pass review Treat **every** review as the final and only review pass. The author will not get another chance to catch missed findings cheaply. - Do not defer SUGGESTION or IMPORTANT items to a later round because a BLOCKING issue exists. - After classifying all findings, re-read every changed file and ask: *"What else is improvable here?"* - Before writing outputs, verify that no obvious quality, maintainability, or correctness issue was left unreported. - Aim to surface the maximum number of actionable findings in this single iteration. ## 8. ## PR Description

Closes #1106
### What changed
Fork silent-update now survives `workflows`-permission rejections: the refusal is classified from the captured stderr tail, escalated **once** with the workflow-write token (`jobParams.sourceToken`), and only a second refusal parks the PR — with a distinct "needs a workflow-write token" reason, never on the gh-1070 "edits revoked" 3-strike trail.

### Key decisions
- Pure classifier `isWorkflowsPermissionRejection(stderrTail)` in `js/common/validationLiveness.js` — matches the GitHub App form (`refusing to allow a GitHub App to create or update workflow …`) and the OAuth/PAT form (`… without 'workflow' scope`); anything else (protected-branch hooks, real edit revocations, truncated tails) stays generic (AC5, E2, E4).
- Escalation reuses the identical git chain — only env `GH_TOKEN` is swapped to `sourceToken` and restored in `finally` (even on exception); the token never enters script source or logs (AC1, AC7). One escalated attempt per PR per tick via a `tickWorkflowEscalations` claim (park-reset + silent-update-behind can both route a parked fork in one pass).
- Distinct park marker `🔐 workflow-write park (gh-1106) … parked-head: <sha>` — one per parked head (comment-deduped), parseable by the existing gh-994 head-change reset, so the first successful escalation (or any head-moving push) lifts the park and CI re-enters via the standard lanes (AC3, AC4).
- Same classify+escalate applied to the base-repo provider path `_ghSilentUpdateBranch` (optional 5th `escalationToken` arg; without it the refusal surfaces a distinct error naming the capability gap) (AC6, E1).
- DRY ticks log the planned escalation and push/park nothing (E3). `machine-sm.yml`/`factory-sm.yml` already deliver `sourceToken` — no workflow wiring changed; open question (App `Workflows: write` grant vs PAT `workflow` scope) stays an operator decision, both shapes are supported.

flowchart TD

# gh-1106: SM: fork silent-update must escalate token on 'workflows' permission rejection instead of guest-parking

## Description

## Goal — fork silent-update survives `workflows`-permission rejection (v1)
One sentence: **an approved fork PR whose update-from-main touches `.github/workflows/*` gets its branch updated and merged by the SM instead of parking guest-style forever.**

Today the SM's fork silent-update (`js/smAgent.js` ~2380–2440) pushes the `main` merge into the fork head with `silentToken` (= the caller's `github.token`, `github-actions[bot]`). `GITHUB_TOKEN` can never create/update workflow files (no `workflows` permission exists for it, `permissions:` cannot grant it). As soon as `main` has a workflow-file change the fork branch lacks, every push is rejected, `recordForkSilentUpdateFailure` counts it as "maintainer edits revoked", and after 3 ticks the PR is parked guest-style with `validation_failed`, which then holds because "the head predates the park event (no new push since)". Deadlock: no push → park holds → no push.

Live case: IstiN/flutter_agent_harness#1591 (fork `YuryBY`, `maintainerCanModify=true`, APPROVED, BEHIND), ticks 2026-10-19 17:16/17:17:
```
! [remote rejected] HEAD -> fix/android-dap-home-sandbox (refusing to allow a GitHub App to create or update workflow `.github/workflows/build-mobile.yml` without `workflows` permission)
❌ pr-1591 fork silent-update parked guest-style after 3 consecutive push failures (gh-1070 AC3)
🅿️ pr-1591 validation_failed holds — the head predates the park event (no new push since)
```

## Why this framing
- Retracted: "maintainer edits were revoked" — the misdiagnosis gh-1070 AC3 applies to *every* push failure. This rejection is a token-capability fact, not an author decision, and it is deterministic (retrying with the same token can never succeed).
- Retracted: fixing in workflow YAML. `machine-sm.yml` / `factory-sm.yml` already deliver both `silentToken` and `sourceToken`; the decision belongs to the engine.

## Architecture
Subject of every action = **the fork PR head branch** (`head.repo.full_name`:`head.ref`), never the base repo.

```
silent push (silentToken) ──ok──▶ done (no CI event, as today)
        │ rejected
        ▼ classify stderr tail
  workflows-permission? ──no──▶ existing gh-1070 AC3 trail (unchanged)
        │ yes
        ▼
  escalated push (sourceToken: App installation token or PAT) ──ok──▶ head moved;
        │                                                      CI fires normally (acceptable: head changed, revalidation is required anyway)
        │ rejected (escalation token also lacks workflow write)
        ▼
  park with a DISTINCT reason "update needs workflow-write token" (actionable, not "edits revoked"); not counted toward the 3-strike trail
```
Invariants:
- Same token-in-env pattern as today: `forkPushTokenUrl` keeps `${GH_TOKEN}` in the URL; the escalation only swaps env `GH_TOKEN` and restores it in `finally`. The token never appears in script source or logs.
- Classifier is a pure function `isWorkflowsPermissionRejection(stderrTail)` in `js/common/validationLiveness.js` (matches `refusing to allow a GitHub App to create or update workflow` and `refusing to allow an OAuth App ... without \`workflow\` scope`).
- One escalated attempt per PR per tick.
- The same classification + escalation applies to the non-fork path `_ghSilentUpdateBranch` (`js/common/smProvider.js` ~839) for base-repo branches.
- A `validation_failed` park created by a workflows-permission rejection is lifted when the escalated push moves the head (the head now post-dates the park).

## Capability surface (tokens available to the tick)
| Token | Source | Workflow-file write | Push fires CI | Use |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `silentToken` | `github.token` | **never** (platform fact) | no | default silent update (core, unchanged) |
| App installation token | `create-github-app-token` (APP_ID/APP_PRIVATE_KEY) | only if App has *Workflows: write* | yes | escalation (core) |
| `SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN` PAT | secret | only with `workflow` scope | yes | escalation fallback when no App (core) |
Excluded: requesting permissions at runtime (impossible); rewriting the merge to skip workflow files (corrupts the branch).

Pinned platform facts (each with +/- test via stderr fixtures): `GITHUB_TOKEN` push touching `.github/workflows/**` is rejected; same push with workflow-capable token succeeds; push not touching workflows succeeds with `GITHUB_TOKEN`.

## Security
- Escalation token is a write token to a **fork** owned by a third party, used only under `maintainerCanModify=true` (existing gate, unchanged).
- Never log the token; stderr tail stays redacted (existing redaction).
- Escalation pushes only the SM-built merge commit of `main` into head — no author content is executed before the push.

## Acceptance criteria
- **AC1** — workflows-permission rejection with `silentToken` triggers exactly one escalated push with `sourceToken` in the same tick (UT-1, IT-1).
- **AC2** — that rejection does **not** increment the gh-1070 failure trail and does not park guest-style (UT-2).
- **AC3** — if escalation also fails with the same class, the PR parks with a distinct reason/marker naming the missing token capability (UT-3).
- **AC4** — after a successful escalated push the `validation_failed` hold is released by the existing "new push since park" rule and CI is dispatched (IT-2).
- **AC5** — non-workflows rejections keep today's behavior byte-identical (REG-1).
- **AC6** — same behavior on the base-repo path `_ghSilentUpdateBranch` (UT-4).
- **AC7** — `GH_TOKEN` env is restored after escalation even on exception (UT-5).

## Test plan
- `UT-1..5` in `js/unit-tests` with stderr fixtures (the exact #1591 line + OAuth-scope variant + unrelated rejection).
- `IT-1/2` SM tick harness with stubbed `cli_execute_command`: first push rejected → second with swapped env succeeds → head moves.
- `REG-1` existing gh-1070 / gh-1074 fork tests unchanged and green.
- Red REG blocks merge even if UT/IT are green.

### Edge cases
- **E1** — no App and PAT lacks `workflow` scope → AC3 park, one marker, no infinite retries.
- **E2** — author disables maintainer edits mid-flight → old gh-1070 path (different stderr).
- **E3** — dry-run: logs the planned escalation, no push.
- **E4** — stderr truncated before the marker phrase → treated as generic (safe default).

## Non-goals
- Changing tokens wired in `machine-sm.yml` / `factory-sm.yml`.
- Auto-unparking PRs parked by genuine maintainer-edit revocation.

## Open questions
- Does the fa App have *Workflows: write*? If not: grant it, or rely on PAT `workflow` scope.

      - name: Checkout dmtools-agents (rule engine + agent configs)
        uses: actions/checkout@8ade135a41bc03ea155e62e844d188df1ea18608 # v4
        with:
          repository: IstiN/dmtools-agents
          ref: ${{ env.DMTOOLS_AGENTS_REF }}
          path: dmtools-agents

      - name: Install dmtools CLI (pinned release)
        run: sh dmtools-agents/setup/install.sh
        env:
          DMTOOLS_VERSION: ${{ env.DMTOOLS_VERSION }}

      - name: Reconcile the machine loop
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          GH_REPO: ${{ github.repository }}
          DRY_RUN_INPUT: ${{ github.event.inputs.dryRun }}
        run: |
          # sm_github.json defaults point at the sm repo; the target repo
          # override rides the standard CLI JSON deep-merge.
          override="{\"params\":{\"jobParams\":{\"repo\":\"$SM_REPO\""
          if [ "$DRY_RUN_INPUT" = "true" ]; then
            override="$override,\"dryRun\":true"
          fi
          override="$override}}"
          cd dmtools-agents && dmtools run "$SM_CONFIG" "$override"

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1116
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/dmtools-agents/pull/1116
- **Title**: gh-1106 SM: fork silent-update must escalate token on 'workflows' permission rejection instead of guest-parking
- **Author**: dmtools-factory-bot[bot]
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1106` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 8
- **Additions**: +850
- **Deletions**: -30
- **Created**: 2026-10-19T18:18:22Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-19T20:52:39Z

## PR Description

Closes #1106
### What changed
Fork silent-update now survives `workflows`-permission rejections: the refusal is classified from the captured stderr tail, escalated **once** with the workflow-write token (`jobParams.sourceToken`), and only a second refusal parks the PR — with a distinct "needs a workflow-write token" reason, never on the gh-1070 "edits revoked" 3-strike trail.

### Key decisions
- Pure classifier `isWorkflowsPermissionRejection(stderrTail)` in `js/common/validationLiveness.js` — matches the GitHub App form (`refusing to allow a GitHub App to create or update workflow …`) and the OAuth/PAT form (`… without 'workflow' scope`); anything else (protected-branch hooks, real edit revocations, truncated tails) stays generic (AC5, E2, E4).
- Escalation reuses the identical git chain — only env `GH_TOKEN` is swapped to `sourceToken` and restored in `finally` (even on exception); the token never enters script source or logs (AC1, AC7). One escalated attempt per PR per tick via a `tickWorkflowEscalations` claim (park-reset + silent-update-behind can both route a parked fork in one pass).
- Distinct park marker `🔐 workflow-write park (gh-1106) … parked-head: <sha>` — one per parked head (comment-deduped), parseable by the existing gh-994 head-change reset, so the first successful escalation (or any head-moving push) lifts the park and CI re-enters via the standard lanes (AC3, AC4).
- Same classify+escalate applied to the base-repo provider path `_ghSilentUpdateBranch` (optional 5th `escalationToken` arg; without it the refusal surfaces a distinct error naming the capability gap) (AC6, E1).
- DRY ticks log the planned escalation and push/park nothing (E3). `machine-sm.yml`/`factory-sm.yml` already deliver `sourceToken` — no workflow wiring changed; open question (App `Workflows: write` grant vs PAT `workflow` scope) stays an operator decision, both shapes are supported.

### How to verify
```bash
dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_all.json   # 4754 tests — includes new gh-1106 suites
dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_validationLiveness.json

# gh-1106: SM: fork silent-update must escalate token on 'workflows' permission rejection instead of guest-parking

## Description

## Goal — fork silent-update survives `workflows`-permission rejection (v1)
One sentence: **an approved fork PR whose update-from-main touches `.github/workflows/*` gets its branch updated and merged by the SM instead of parking guest-style forever.**

Today the SM's fork silent-update (`js/smAgent.js` ~2380–2440) pushes the `main` merge into the fork head with `silentToken` (= the caller's `github.token`, `github-actions[bot]`). `GITHUB_TOKEN` can never create/update workflow files (no `workflows` permission exists for it, `permissions:` cannot grant it). As soon as `main` has a workflow-file change the fork branch lacks, every push is rejected, `recordForkSilentUpdateFailure` counts it as "maintainer edits revoked", and after 3 ticks the PR is parked guest-style with `validation_failed`, which then holds because "the head predates the park event (no new push since)". Deadlock: no push → park holds → no push.

Live case: IstiN/flutter_agent_harness#1591 (fork `YuryBY`, `maintainerCanModify=true`, APPROVED, BEHIND), ticks 2026-10-19 17:16/17:17:
```
! [remote rejected] HEAD -> fix/android-dap-home-sandbox (refusing to allow a GitHub App to create or update workflow `.github/workflows/build-mobile.yml` without `workflows` permission)
❌ pr-1591 fork silent-update parked guest-style after 3 consecutive push failures (gh-1070 AC3)
🅿️ pr-1591 validation_failed holds — the head predates the park event (no new push since)
```

## Why this framing
- Retracted: "maintainer edits were revoked" — the misdiagnosis gh-1070 AC3 applies to *every* push failure. This rejection is a token-capability fact, not an author decision, and it is deterministic (retrying with the same token can never succeed).
- Retracted: fixing in workflow YAML. `machine-sm.yml` / `factory-sm.yml` already deliver both `silentToken` and `sourceToken`; the decision belongs to the engine.

## Architecture
Subject of every action = **the fork PR head branch** (`head.repo.full_name`:`head.ref`), never the base repo.

```
silent push (silentToken) ──ok──▶ done (no CI event, as today)
        │ rejected
        ▼ classify stderr tail
  workflows-permission? ──no──▶ existing gh-1070 AC3 trail (unchanged)
        │ yes
        ▼
  escalated push (sourceToken: App installation token or PAT) ──ok──▶ head moved;
        │                                                      CI fires normally (acceptable: head changed, revalidation is required anyway)
        │ rejected (escalation token also lacks workflow write)
        ▼
  park with a DISTINCT reason "update needs workflow-write token" (actionable, not "edits revoked"); not counted toward the 3-strike trail
```
Invariants:
- Same token-in-env pattern as today: `forkPushTokenUrl` keeps `${GH_TOKEN}` in the URL; the escalation only swaps env `GH_TOKEN` and restores it in `finally`. The token never appears in script source or logs.
- Classifier is a pure function `isWorkflowsPermissionRejection(stderrTail)` in `js/common/validationLiveness.js` (matches `refusing to allow a GitHub App to create or update workflow` and `refusing to allow an OAuth App ... without \`workflow\` scope`).
- One escalated attempt per PR per tick.
- The same classification + escalation applies to the non-fork path `_ghSilentUpdateBranch` (`js/common/smProvider.js` ~839) for base-repo branches.
- A `validation_failed` park created by a workflows-permission rejection is lifted when the escalated push moves the head (the head now post-dates the park).

## Capability surface (tokens available to the tick)
| Token | Source | Workflow-file write | Push fires CI | Use |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `silentToken` | `github.token` | **never** (platform fact) | no | default silent update (core, unchanged) |
| App installation token | `create-github-app-token` (APP_ID/APP_PRIVATE_KEY) | only if App has *Workflows: write* | yes | escalation (core) |
| `SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN` PAT | secret | only with `workflow` scope | yes | escalation fallback when no App (core) |
Excluded: requesting permissions at runtime (impossible); rewriting the merge to skip workflow files (corrupts the branch).

Pinned platform facts (each with +/- test via stderr fixtures): `GITHUB_TOKEN` push touching `.github/workflows/**` is rejected; same push with workflow-capable token succeeds; push not touching workflows succeeds with `GITHUB_TOKEN`.

## Security
- Escalation token is a write token to a **fork** owned by a third party, used only under `maintainerCanModify=true` (existing gate, unchanged).
- Never log the token; stderr tail stays redacted (existing redaction).
- Escalation pushes only the SM-built merge commit of `main` into head — no author content is executed before the push.

## Acceptance criteria
- **AC1** — workflows-permission rejection with `silentToken` triggers exactly one escalated push with `sourceToken` in the same tick (UT-1, IT-1).
- **AC2** — that rejection does **not** increment the gh-1070 failure trail and does not park guest-style (UT-2).
- **AC3** — if escalation also fails with the same class, the PR parks with a distinct reason/marker naming the missing token capability (UT-3).
- **AC4** — after a successful escalated push the `validation_failed` hold is released by the existing "new push since park" rule and CI is dispatched (IT-2).
- **AC5** — non-workflows rejections keep today's behavior byte-identical (REG-1).
- **AC6** — same behavior on the base-repo path `_ghSilentUpdateBranch` (UT-4).
- **AC7** — `GH_TOKEN` env is restored after escalation even on exception (UT-5).

## Test plan
- `UT-1..5` in `js/unit-tests` with stderr fixtures (the exact #1591 line + OAuth-scope variant + unrelated rejection).
- `IT-1/2` SM tick harness with stubbed `cli_execute_command`: first push rejected → second with swapped env succeeds → head moves.
- `REG-1` existing gh-1070 / gh-1074 fork tests unchanged and green.
- Red REG blocks merge even if UT/IT are green.

### Edge cases
- **E1** — no App and PAT lacks `workflow` scope → AC3 park, one marker, no infinite retries.
- **E2** — author disables maintainer edits mid-flight → old gh-1070 path (different stderr).
- **E3** — dry-run: logs the planned escalation, no push.
- **E4** — stderr truncated before the marker phrase → treated as generic (safe default).

## Non-goals
- Changing tokens wired in `machine-sm.yml` / `factory-sm.yml`.
- Auto-unparking PRs parked by genuine maintainer-edit revocation.

## Open questions
- Does the fa App have *Workflows: write*? If not: grant it, or rely on PAT `workflow` scope.

## References
- IstiN/flutter_agent_harness#1591; gh-1070 AC3, gh-1074 (fork silent-update trail); #687 (silent token); awf#52 (App token).

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1116
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/dmtools-agents/pull/1116
- **Title**: gh-1106 SM: fork silent-update must escalate token on 'workflows' permission rejection instead of guest-parking
- **Author**: dmtools-factory-bot[bot]
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1106` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 8
- **Additions**: +850
- **Deletions**: -30
- **Created**: 2026-10-19T18:18:22Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-19T20:52:39Z

## PR Description

Closes #1106
### What changed
Fork silent-update now survives `workflows`-permission rejections: the refusal is classified from the captured stderr tail, escalated **once** with the workflow-write token (`jobParams.sourceToken`), and only a second refusal parks the PR — with a distinct "needs a workflow-write token" reason, never on the gh-1070 "edits revoked" 3-strike trail.

### Key decisions
- Pure classifier `isWorkflowsPermissionRejection(stderrTail)` in `js/common/validationLiveness.js` — matches the GitHub App form (`refusing to allow a GitHub App to create or update workflow …`) and the OAuth/PAT form (`… without 'workflow' scope`); anything else (protected-branch hooks, real edit revocations, truncated tails) stays generic (AC5, E2, E4).
- Escalation reuses the identical git chain — only env `GH_TOKEN` is swapped to `sourceToken` and restored in `finally` (even on exception); the token never enters script source or logs (AC1, AC7). One escalated attempt per PR per tick via a `tickWorkflowEscalations` claim (park-reset + silent-update-behind can both route a parked fork in one pass).
- Distinct park marker `🔐 workflow-write park (gh-1106) … parked-head: <sha>` — one per parked head (comment-deduped), parseable by the existing gh-994 head-change reset, so the first successful escalation (or any head-moving push) lifts the park and CI re-enters via the standard lanes (AC3, AC4).
- Same classify+escalate applied to the base-repo provider path `_ghSilentUpdateBranch` (optional 5th `escalationToken` arg; without it the refusal surfaces a distinct error naming the capability gap) (AC6, E1).
- DRY ticks log the planned escalation and push/park nothing (E3). `machine-sm.yml`/`factory-sm.yml` already deliver `sourceToken` — no workflow wiring changed; open question (App `Workflows: write` grant vs PAT `workflow` scope) stays an operator decision, both shapes are supported.

### How to verify
```bash
dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_all.json   # 4754 tests — includes new gh-1106 suites
dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_validationLiveness.json
dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_smProvider.json && dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_smAgent.json

# gh-1106: SM: fork silent-update must escalate token on 'workflows' permission rejection instead of guest-parking

## Description

## Goal — fork silent-update survives `workflows`-permission rejection (v1)
One sentence: **an approved fork PR whose update-from-main touches `.github/workflows/*` gets its branch updated and merged by the SM instead of parking guest-style forever.**

Today the SM's fork silent-update (`js/smAgent.js` ~2380–2440) pushes the `main` merge into the fork head with `silentToken` (= the caller's `github.token`, `github-actions[bot]`). `GITHUB_TOKEN` can never create/update workflow files (no `workflows` permission exists for it, `permissions:` cannot grant it). As soon as `main` has a workflow-file change the fork branch lacks, every push is rejected, `recordForkSilentUpdateFailure` counts it as "maintainer edits revoked", and after 3 ticks the PR is parked guest-style with `validation_failed`, which then holds because "the head predates the park event (no new push since)". Deadlock: no push → park holds → no push.

Live case: IstiN/flutter_agent_harness#1591 (fork `YuryBY`, `maintainerCanModify=true`, APPROVED, BEHIND), ticks 2026-10-19 17:16/17:17:
```
! [remote rejected] HEAD -> fix/android-dap-home-sandbox (refusing to allow a GitHub App to create or update workflow `.github/workflows/build-mobile.yml` without `workflows` permission)
❌ pr-1591 fork silent-update parked guest-style after 3 consecutive push failures (gh-1070 AC3)
🅿️ pr-1591 validation_failed holds — the head predates the park event (no new push since)
```

## Why this framing
- Retracted: "maintainer edits were revoked" — the misdiagnosis gh-1070 AC3 applies to *every* push failure. This rejection is a token-capability fact, not an author decision, and it is deterministic (retrying with the same token can never succeed).
- Retracted: fixing in workflow YAML. `machine-sm.yml` / `factory-sm.yml` already deliver both `silentToken` and `sourceToken`; the decision belongs to the engine.

## Architecture
Subject of every action = **the fork PR head branch** (`head.repo.full_name`:`head.ref`), never the base repo.

```
silent push (silentToken) ──ok──▶ done (no CI event, as today)
        │ rejected
        ▼ classify stderr tail
  workflows-permission? ──no──▶ existing gh-1070 AC3 trail (unchanged)
        │ yes
        ▼
  escalated push (sourceToken: App installation token or PAT) ──ok──▶ head moved;
        │                                                      CI fires normally (acceptable: head changed, revalidation is required anyway)
        │ rejected (escalation token also lacks workflow write)
        ▼
  park with a DISTINCT reason "update needs workflow-write token" (actionable, not "edits revoked"); not counted toward the 3-strike trail
```
Invariants:
- Same token-in-env pattern as today: `forkPushTokenUrl` keeps `${GH_TOKEN}` in the URL; the escalation only swaps env `GH_TOKEN` and restores it in `finally`. The token never appears in script source or logs.
- Classifier is a pure function `isWorkflowsPermissionRejection(stderrTail)` in `js/common/validationLiveness.js` (matches `refusing to allow a GitHub App to create or update workflow` and `refusing to allow an OAuth App ... without \`workflow\` scope`).
- One escalated attempt per PR per tick.
- The same classification + escalation applies to the non-fork path `_ghSilentUpdateBranch` (`js/common/smProvider.js` ~839) for base-repo branches.
- A `validation_failed` park created by a workflows-permission rejection is lifted when the escalated push moves the head (the head now post-dates the park).

## Capability surface (tokens available to the tick)
| Token | Source | Workflow-file write | Push fires CI | Use |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `silentToken` | `github.token` | **never** (platform fact) | no | default silent update (core, unchanged) |
| App installation token | `create-github-app-token` (APP_ID/APP_PRIVATE_KEY) | only if App has *Workflows: write* | yes | escalation (core) |
| `SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN` PAT | secret | only with `workflow` scope | yes | escalation fallback when no App (core) |
Excluded: requesting permissions at runtime (impossible); rewriting the merge to skip workflow files (corrupts the branch).

Pinned platform facts (each with +/- test via stderr fixtures): `GITHUB_TOKEN` push touching `.github/workflows/**` is rejected; same push with workflow-capable token succeeds; push not touching workflows succeeds with `GITHUB_TOKEN`.

## Security
- Escalation token is a write token to a **fork** owned by a third party, used only under `maintainerCanModify=true` (existing gate, unchanged).
- Never log the token; stderr tail stays redacted (existing redaction).
- Escalation pushes only the SM-built merge commit of `main` into head — no author content is executed before the push.

## Acceptance criteria
- **AC1** — workflows-permission rejection with `silentToken` triggers exactly one escalated push with `sourceToken` in the same tick (UT-1, IT-1).
- **AC2** — that rejection does **not** increment the gh-1070 failure trail and does not park guest-style (UT-2).
- **AC3** — if escalation also fails with the same class, the PR parks with a distinct reason/marker naming the missing token capability (UT-3).
- **AC4** — after a successful escalated push the `validation_failed` hold is released by the existing "new push since park" rule and CI is dispatched (IT-2).
- **AC5** — non-workflows rejections keep today's behavior byte-identical (REG-1).
- **AC6** — same behavior on the base-repo path `_ghSilentUpdateBranch` (UT-4).
- **AC7** — `GH_TOKEN` env is restored after escalation even on exception (UT-5).

## Test plan
- `UT-1..5` in `js/unit-tests` with stderr fixtures (the exact #1591 line + OAuth-scope variant + unrelated rejection).
- `IT-1/2` SM tick harness with stubbed `cli_execute_command`: first push rejected → second with swapped env succeeds → head moves.
- `REG-1` existing gh-1070 / gh-1074 fork tests unchanged and green.
- Red REG blocks merge even if UT/IT are green.

### Edge cases
- **E1** — no App and PAT lacks `workflow` scope → AC3 park, one marker, no infinite retries.
- **E2** — author disables maintainer edits mid-flight → old gh-1070 path (different stderr).
- **E3** — dry-run: logs the planned escalation, no push.
- **E4** — stderr truncated before the marker phrase → treated as generic (safe default).

## Non-goals
- Changing tokens wired in `machine-sm.yml` / `factory-sm.yml`.
- Auto-unparking PRs parked by genuine maintainer-edit revocation.

## Open questions
- Does the fa App have *Workflows: write*? If not: grant it, or rely on PAT `workflow` scope.

## References
- IstiN/flutter_agent_harness#1591; gh-1070 AC3, gh-1074 (fork silent-update trail); #687 (silent token); awf#52 (App token).

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1116
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/dmtools-agents/pull/1116
- **Title**: gh-1106 SM: fork silent-update must escalate token on 'workflows' permission rejection instead of guest-parking
- **Author**: dmtools-factory-bot[bot]
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1106` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 8
- **Additions**: +850
- **Deletions**: -30
- **Created**: 2026-10-19T18:18:22Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-19T20:52:39Z

## PR Description

Closes #1106
### What changed
Fork silent-update now survives `workflows`-permission rejections: the refusal is classified from the captured stderr tail, escalated **once** with the workflow-write token (`jobParams.sourceToken`), and only a second refusal parks the PR — with a distinct "needs a workflow-write token" reason, never on the gh-1070 "edits revoked" 3-strike trail.

### Key decisions
- Pure classifier `isWorkflowsPermissionRejection(stderrTail)` in `js/common/validationLiveness.js` — matches the GitHub App form (`refusing to allow a GitHub App to create or update workflow …`) and the OAuth/PAT form (`… without 'workflow' scope`); anything else (protected-branch hooks, real edit revocations, truncated tails) stays generic (AC5, E2, E4).
- Escalation reuses the identical git chain — only env `GH_TOKEN` is swapped to `sourceToken` and restored in `finally` (even on exception); the token never enters script source or logs (AC1, AC7). One escalated attempt per PR per tick via a `tickWorkflowEscalations` claim (park-reset + silent-update-behind can both route a parked fork in one pass).
- Distinct park marker `🔐 workflow-write park (gh-1106) … parked-head: <sha>` — one per parked head (comment-deduped), parseable by the existing gh-994 head-change reset, so the first successful escalation (or any head-moving push) lifts the park and CI re-enters via the standard lanes (AC3, AC4).
- Same classify+escalate applied to the base-repo provider path `_ghSilentUpdateBranch` (optional 5th `escalationToken` arg; without it the refusal surfaces a distinct error naming the capability gap) (AC6, E1).
- DRY ticks log the planned escalation and push/park nothing (E3). `machine-sm.yml`/`factory-sm.yml` already deliver `sourceToken` — no workflow wiring changed; open question (App `Workflows: write` grant vs PAT `workflow` scope) stays an operator decision, both shapes are supported.

### How to verify
```bash
dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_all.json   # 4754 tests — includes new gh-1106 suites
dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_validationLiveness.json
dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_smProvider.json && dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_smAgent.json
```
- UT-1..5 / IT-1: fork lane tests in `test_smAgent.js` ("fork silent-update workflow-write escalation (gh-1106)"); UT-4 in `test_smProvider.js`; REG-1 pins non-workflows failures byte-identical (no env swap, trail unchanged).

<details><summary>Architecture</summary>

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  P[silent push — silentToken] -->|ok| D[done — no CI event]
  P -->|rejected| C{isWorkflowsPermissionRejection?}
  C -->|no| T[gh-1070 3-strike trail — unchanged]
  C -->|yes| E[escalated push — GH_TOKEN:=sourceToken]
  E -->|ok| M[head moved — gh-994 park reset, validation re-dispatch]
  E -->|workflows refusal again| PK[park: workflow-write park marker — not on the trail]
```

</details>

# gh-1106: SM: fork silent-update must escalate token on 'workflows' permission rejection instead of guest-parking

## Description

## Goal — fork silent-update survives `workflows`-permission rejection (v1)
One sentence: **an approved fork PR whose update-from-main touches `.github/workflows/*` gets its branch updated and merged by the SM instead of parking guest-style forever.**

Today the SM's fork silent-update (`js/smAgent.js` ~2380–2440) pushes the `main` merge into the fork head with `silentToken` (= the caller's `github.token`, `github-actions[bot]`). `GITHUB_TOKEN` can never create/update workflow files (no `workflows` permission exists for it, `permissions:` cannot grant it). As soon as `main` has a workflow-file change the fork branch lacks, every push is rejected, `recordForkSilentUpdateFailure` counts it as "maintainer edits revoked", and after 3 ticks the PR is parked guest-style with `validation_failed`, which then holds because "the head predates the park event (no new push since)". Deadlock: no push → park holds → no push.

Live case: IstiN/flutter_agent_harness#1591 (fork `YuryBY`, `maintainerCanModify=true`, APPROVED, BEHIND), ticks 2026-10-19 17:16/17:17:
```
! [remote rejected] HEAD -> fix/android-dap-home-sandbox (refusing to allow a GitHub App to create or update workflow `.github/workflows/build-mobile.yml` without `workflows` permission)
❌ pr-1591 fork silent-update parked guest-style after 3 consecutive push failures (gh-1070 AC3)
🅿️ pr-1591 validation_failed holds — the head predates the park event (no new push since)
```

## Why this framing
- Retracted: "maintainer edits were revoked" — the misdiagnosis gh-1070 AC3 applies to *every* push failure. This rejection is a token-capability fact, not an author decision, and it is deterministic (retrying with the same token can never succeed).
- Retracted: fixing in workflow YAML. `machine-sm.yml` / `factory-sm.yml` already deliver both `silentToken` and `sourceToken`; the decision belongs to the engine.

## Architecture
Subject of every action = **the fork PR head branch** (`head.repo.full_name`:`head.ref`), never the base repo.

```
silent push (silentToken) ──ok──▶ done (no CI event, as today)
        │ rejected
        ▼ classify stderr tail
  workflows-permission? ──no──▶ existing gh-1070 AC3 trail (unchanged)
        │ yes
        ▼
  escalated push (sourceToken: App installation token or PAT) ──ok──▶ head moved;
        │                                                      CI fires normally (acceptable: head changed, revalidation is required anyway)
        │ rejected (escalation token also lacks workflow write)
        ▼
  park with a DISTINCT reason "update needs workflow-write token" (actionable, not "edits revoked"); not counted toward the 3-strike trail
```
Invariants:
- Same token-in-env pattern as today: `forkPushTokenUrl` keeps `${GH_TOKEN}` in the URL; the escalation only swaps env `GH_TOKEN` and restores it in `finally`. The token never appears in script source or logs.
- Classifier is a pure function `isWorkflowsPermissionRejection(stderrTail)` in `js/common/validationLiveness.js` (matches `refusing to allow a GitHub App to create or update workflow` and `refusing to allow an OAuth App ... without \`workflow\` scope`).
- One escalated attempt per PR per tick.
- The same classification + escalation applies to the non-fork path `_ghSilentUpdateBranch` (`js/common/smProvider.js` ~839) for base-repo branches.
- A `validation_failed` park created by a workflows-permission rejection is lifted when the escalated push moves the head (the head now post-dates the park).

## Capability surface (tokens available to the tick)
| Token | Source | Workflow-file write | Push fires CI | Use |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `silentToken` | `github.token` | **never** (platform fact) | no | default silent update (core, unchanged) |
| App installation token | `create-github-app-token` (APP_ID/APP_PRIVATE_KEY) | only if App has *Workflows: write* | yes | escalation (core) |
| `SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN` PAT | secret | only with `workflow` scope | yes | escalation fallback when no App (core) |
Excluded: requesting permissions at runtime (impossible); rewriting the merge to skip workflow files (corrupts the branch).

Pinned platform facts (each with +/- test via stderr fixtures): `GITHUB_TOKEN` push touching `.github/workflows/**` is rejected; same push with workflow-capable token succeeds; push not touching workflows succeeds with `GITHUB_TOKEN`.

## Security
- Escalation token is a write token to a **fork** owned by a third party, used only under `maintainerCanModify=true` (existing gate, unchanged).
- Never log the token; stderr tail stays redacted (existing redaction).
- Escalation pushes only the SM-built merge commit of `main` into head — no author content is executed before the push.

## Acceptance criteria
- **AC1** — workflows-permission rejection with `silentToken` triggers exactly one escalated push with `sourceToken` in the same tick (UT-1, IT-1).
- **AC2** — that rejection does **not** increment the gh-1070 failure trail and does not park guest-style (UT-2).
- **AC3** — if escalation also fails with the same class, the PR parks with a distinct reason/marker naming the missing token capability (UT-3).
- **AC4** — after a successful escalated push the `validation_failed` hold is released by the existing "new push since park" rule and CI is dispatched (IT-2).
- **AC5** — non-workflows rejections keep today's behavior byte-identical (REG-1).
- **AC6** — same behavior on the base-repo path `_ghSilentUpdateBranch` (UT-4).
- **AC7** — `GH_TOKEN` env is restored after escalation even on exception (UT-5).

## Test plan
- `UT-1..5` in `js/unit-tests` with stderr fixtures (the exact #1591 line + OAuth-scope variant + unrelated rejection).
- `IT-1/2` SM tick harness with stubbed `cli_execute_command`: first push rejected → second with swapped env succeeds → head moves.
- `REG-1` existing gh-1070 / gh-1074 fork tests unchanged and green.
- Red REG blocks merge even if UT/IT are green.

### Edge cases
- **E1** — no App and PAT lacks `workflow` scope → AC3 park, one marker, no infinite retries.
- **E2** — author disables maintainer edits mid-flight → old gh-1070 path (different stderr).
- **E3** — dry-run: logs the planned escalation, no push.
- **E4** — stderr truncated before the marker phrase → treated as generic (safe default).

## Non-goals
- Changing tokens wired in `machine-sm.yml` / `factory-sm.yml`.
- Auto-unparking PRs parked by genuine maintainer-edit revocation.

## Open questions
- Does the fa App have *Workflows: write*? If not: grant it, or rely on PAT `workflow` scope.

# gh-1106: SM: fork silent-update must escalate token on 'workflows' permission rejection instead of guest-parking

## Description

## Goal — fork silent-update survives `workflows`-permission rejection (v1)
One sentence: **an approved fork PR whose update-from-main touches `.github/workflows/*` gets its branch updated and merged by the SM instead of parking guest-style forever.**

Today the SM's fork silent-update (`js/smAgent.js` ~2380–2440) pushes the `main` merge into the fork head with `silentToken` (= the caller's `github.token`, `github-actions[bot]`). `GITHUB_TOKEN` can never create/update workflow files (no `workflows` permission exists for it, `permissions:` cannot grant it). As soon as `main` has a workflow-file change the fork branch lacks, every push is rejected, `recordForkSilentUpdateFailure` counts it as "maintainer edits revoked", and after 3 ticks the PR is parked guest-style with `validation_failed`, which then holds because "the head predates the park event (no new push since)". Deadlock: no push → park holds → no push.

Live case: IstiN/flutter_agent_harness#1591 (fork `YuryBY`, `maintainerCanModify=true`, APPROVED, BEHIND), ticks 2026-10-19 17:16/17:17:
```
! [remote rejected] HEAD -> fix/android-dap-home-sandbox (refusing to allow a GitHub App to create or update workflow `.github/workflows/build-mobile.yml` without `workflows` permission)
❌ pr-1591 fork silent-update parked guest-style after 3 consecutive push failures (gh-1070 AC3)
🅿️ pr-1591 validation_failed holds — the head predates the park event (no new push since)
```

## Why this framing
- Retracted: "maintainer edits were revoked" — the misdiagnosis gh-1070 AC3 applies to *every* push failure. This rejection is a token-capability fact, not an author decision, and it is deterministic (retrying with the same token can never succeed).
- Retracted: fixing in workflow YAML. `machine-sm.yml` / `factory-sm.yml` already deliver both `silentToken` and `sourceToken`; the decision belongs to the engine.

## Architecture
Subject of every action = **the fork PR head branch** (`head.repo.full_name`:`head.ref`), never the base repo.

```
silent push (silentToken) ──ok──▶ done (no CI event, as today)
        │ rejected
        ▼ classify stderr tail
  workflows-permission? ──no──▶ existing gh-1070 AC3 trail (unchanged)
        │ yes
        ▼
  escalated push (sourceToken: App installation token or PAT) ──ok──▶ head moved;
        │                                                      CI fires normally (acceptable: head changed, revalidation is required anyway)
        │ rejected (escalation token also lacks workflow write)
        ▼
  park with a DISTINCT reason "update needs workflow-write token" (actionable, not "edits revoked"); not counted toward the 3-strike trail
```
Invariants:
- Same token-in-env pattern as today: `forkPushTokenUrl` keeps `${GH_TOKEN}` in the URL; the escalation only swaps env `GH_TOKEN` and restores it in `finally`. The token never appears in script source or logs.
- Classifier is a pure function `isWorkflowsPermissionRejection(stderrTail)` in `js/common/validationLiveness.js` (matches `refusing to allow a GitHub App to create or update workflow` and `refusing to allow an OAuth App ... without \`workflow\` scope`).
- One escalated attempt per PR per tick.
- The same classification + escalation applies to the non-fork path `_ghSilentUpdateBranch` (`js/common/smProvider.js` ~839) for base-repo branches.
- A `validation_failed` park created by a workflows-permission rejection is lifted when the escalated push moves the head (the head now post-dates the park).

## Capability surface (tokens available to the tick)
| Token | Source | Workflow-file write | Push fires CI | Use |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `silentToken` | `github.token` | **never** (platform fact) | no | default silent update (core, unchanged) |
| App installation token | `create-github-app-token` (APP_ID/APP_PRIVATE_KEY) | only if App has *Workflows: write* | yes | escalation (core) |
| `SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN` PAT | secret | only with `workflow` scope | yes | escalation fallback when no App (core) |

## Security
- Escalation token is a write token to a **fork** owned by a third party, used only under `maintainerCanModify=true` (existing gate, unchanged).
- Never log the token; stderr tail stays redacted (existing redaction).
- Escalation pushes only the SM-built merge commit of `main` into head — no author content is executed before the push.

## Acceptance criteria
- **AC1** — workflows-permission rejection with `silentToken` triggers exactly one escalated push with `sourceToken` in the same tick (UT-1, IT-1).
- **AC2** — that rejection does **not** increment the gh-1070 failure trail and does not park guest-style (UT-2).
- **AC3** — if escalation also fails with the same class, the PR parks with a distinct reason/marker naming the missing token capability (UT-3).
- **AC4** — after a successful escalated push the `validation_failed` hold is released by the existing "new push since park" rule and CI is dispatched (IT-2).
- **AC5** — non-workflows rejections keep today's behavior byte-identical (REG-1).
- **AC6** — same behavior on the base-repo path `_ghSilentUpdateBranch` (UT-4).
- **AC7** — `GH_TOKEN` env is restored after escalation even on exception (UT-5).

## Test plan
- `UT-1..5` in `js/unit-tests` with stderr fixtures (the exact #1591 line + OAuth-scope variant + unrelated rejection).
- `IT-1/2` SM tick harness with stubbed `cli_execute_command`: first push rejected → second with swapped env succeeds → head moves.
- `REG-1` existing gh-1070 / gh-1074 fork tests unchanged and green.
- Red REG blocks merge even if UT/IT are green.

- **E1** — no App and PAT lacks `workflow` scope → AC3 park, one marker, no infinite retries.
- **E2** — author disables maintainer edits mid-flight → old gh-1070 path (different stderr).
- **E3** — dry-run: logs the planned escalation, no push.
- **E4** — stderr truncated before the marker phrase → treated as generic (safe default).

## Non-goals
- Changing tokens wired in `machine-sm.yml` / `factory-sm.yml`.
- Auto-unparking PRs parked by genuine maintainer-edit revocation.

- **CI failure (BLOCKING): the `crap` quality gate red on head `2e6f627d`.** The rework input's log fetch failed (`host callback returned invalid JSON`), so the job log was pulled directly with `gh run view --job 118227312912`. Root cause from the ratchet verdict:

- **CI failure (BLOCKING): the `crap` quality gate red on head `2e6f627d`.** The rework input's log fetch failed (`host callback returned invalid JSON`), so the job log was pulled directly with `gh run view --job 118227312912`. Root cause from the ratchet verdict:

  - The gate's policy is "CRAP may only decrease" with `CRAP_THRESHOLD=8`; since CRAP ≥ cyclomatic complexity, any function with CC > 8 exceeds the threshold **even at 100% coverage** — the only cure is splitting the decision branches into helpers.
- **Branch sync:** the pass started with setup's `origin/main` merge staged (auto-resolved, no conflict file). Concluded as merge commit `2ce496fa`, which brings in `#1105`'s CRAP refactors of `checkWipLabel`/`prepareTestPRForReview`/`recoverDirtyReviewTestCase` — those would otherwise re-appear as NEW-over-threshold against the current released baseline.

## Approach

- **RED:** reproduced the exact CI failure locally by mirroring `.github/workflows/quality.yml` step-for-step (pinned `IstiN/crap4js@83ee6201` + `nyc@17`, instrument → run `run_all` for coverage → `crap4js . --baseline` against the released `crap-baseline.json` asset): exit 2 with the same two NEW-over-threshold functions (plus 5 main-side shapes the merge resolves).

Calls, order, `finally`-restores and the error texts are byte-identical (verified by string-concatenation equality and pinned by the `UT-4`/`E1`/`REG-1` suites).

- `js/common/smProvider.js` — split `_ghSilentUpdateBranch`; new module-level helpers `_ghEscalatedUpdate`, `_ghWorkflowWriteTokenError`.

      - name: Checkout dmtools-agents (rule engine + agent configs)

        with:
          repository: IstiN/dmtools-agents
          ref: ${{ env.DMTOOLS_AGENTS_REF }}
          path: dmtools-agents

      - name: Install dmtools CLI (pinned release)
        run: sh dmtools-agents/setup/install.sh
        env:
          DMTOOLS_VERSION: ${{ env.DMTOOLS_VERSION }}

      - name: Reconcile the machine loop
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          GH_REPO: ${{ github.repository }}
          DRY_RUN_INPUT: ${{ github.event.inputs.dryRun }}
        run: |
          # sm_github.json defaults point at the sm repo; the target repo
          # override rides the standard CLI JSON deep-merge.
          override="{\"params\":{\"jobParams\":{\"repo\":\"$SM_REPO\""
          if [ "$DRY_RUN_INPUT" = "true" ]; then
            override="$override,\"dryRun\":true"
          fi
          override="$override}}"
          cd dmtools-agents && dmtools run "$SM_CONFIG" "$override"

# pinned to an immutable SHA; agent code and the dmtools CLI resolve from
# RELEASES at run time via this repo's variables:
#   vars.AGENTS_VERSION  — dmtools-agents release tag ('latest' default)
#   vars.DMTOOLS_VERSION — dmtools-dart CLI release tag ('latest' default)
# Bump a version = repo-settings edit, never a workflow edit.
# NO caller-side concurrency: the factory owns the `machine-sm` group.

name: 'Machine SM'

run-name: >-
  🧹 SM ${{
    github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && 'manual tick' ||
    format('tick {0}', github.event.schedule || '') }}${{
  github.event.inputs.dryRun == 'true' && ' (dry)' || '' }}

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '*/10 * * * *'   # short ticks — the engine idles when busy
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      dryRun:
        description: 'Log the plan, perform no action'
        required: false
        type: boolean
        default: true

permissions:
  contents: write         # checkout + silent update-branch pushes
  issues: write           # labels + close-issue safety net
  pull-requests: write    # update-branch + merge
  checks: write           # bridge-free validation stamps
  actions: write          # workflow_dispatch on the teammate workflow

jobs:
  sm:
    # Pinned to the immutable SHA of IstiN/dmtools-agentic-workflows main
    # (the frozen machine-loop home; bump the SHA only together with the
    # matching loop change).
    uses: IstiN/dmtools-agentic-workflows/.github/workflows/factory-sm.yml@main
    with:
      # No .dmtools/config.js in this repo — the machine logins ride the
      # deployment-level input (#687, gh-728), exactly like the factory's
      # contract. Comma-separated LIST: the agent harness bot AND the CI
      # bot — github-actions[bot] authors its own PRs (live fa PR #1249)
      # and must ride the machine path (owner directive 2026-10-05).
      machine-author: 'ai-teammate,github-actions[bot],dmtools-factory-bot'
      # This repo dispatches no CI on PR heads (docs checks only) — the SM
      # leaves validation to the event-driven merge bot and labels.
      ci-workflow: ''
      # Manual ticks default to dry; cron ticks run live.
      dryRun: ${{ github.event.inputs.dryRun || 'false' }}
      # Factory-state snapshot → factory-data branch (board: site/factory,
      # third tab; fa machine-sm.yml parity — transport lives in
      # js/factoryState.js, publishing is opt-in per factory).
      state-publish: '{"channel":"release","tag":"factory-data","asset":"agents-state.json"}'
      # Silent branch updates: input channel (github.token via secrets/in
      # blocks arrives empty through a reusable call — live-verified).
      silent-token: ${{ github.token }}
    secrets:
      SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN }}
      # App auth (awf#52): minted installation token wins over the PAT
      # inside the factory when both secrets are present.
      APP_ID: ${{ secrets.APP_ID }}
      APP_PRIVATE_KEY: ${{ secrets.APP_PRIVATE_KEY }}
      SILENT_GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.SILENT_GH_TOKEN }}

- name: Checkout target repository
        uses: actions/checkout@8ade135a41bc03ea155e62e844d188df1ea18608 # v4
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Checkout dmtools-agents (rule engine + agent configs)
        uses: actions/checkout@8ade135a41bc03ea155e62e844d188df1ea18608 # v4
        with:
          repository: IstiN/dmtools-agents
          ref: ${{ env.DMTOOLS_AGENTS_REF }}
          path: dmtools-agents

      - name: Install dmtools CLI (pinned release)
        run: sh dmtools-agents/setup/install.sh
        env:
          DMTOOLS_VERSION: ${{ env.DMTOOLS_VERSION }}

      - name: Reconcile the machine loop
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          GH_REPO: ${{ github.repository }}
          DRY_RUN_INPUT: ${{ github.event.inputs.dryRun }}
        run: |
          # sm_github.json defaults point at the sm repo; the target repo
          # override rides the standard CLI JSON deep-merge.
          override="{\"params\":{\"jobParams\":{\"repo\":\"$SM_REPO\""
          if [ "$DRY_RUN_INPUT" = "true" ]; then
            override="$override,\"dryRun\":true"
          fi
          override="$override}}"
          cd dmtools-agents && dmtools run "$SM_CONFIG" "$override"

=== machine-sm.yml jobParams wiring ===
# Machine SM — thin stub over the FROZEN machine loop
# (IstiN/dmtools-agentic-workflows, reusable).
#
# Same freeze contract as dmtools-dart's machine-sm.yml: the workflow is
# pinned to an immutable SHA; agent code and the dmtools CLI resolve from
# RELEASES at run time via this repo's variables:
#   vars.AGENTS_VERSION  — dmtools-agents release tag ('latest' default)
#   vars.DMTOOLS_VERSION — dmtools-dart CLI release tag ('latest' default)
# Bump a version = repo-settings edit, never a workflow edit.
# NO caller-side concurrency: the factory owns the `machine-sm` group.

name: 'Machine SM'

run-name: >-
  🧹 SM ${{
    github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && 'manual tick' ||
    format('tick {0}', github.event.schedule || '') }}${{
  github.event.inputs.dryRun == 'true' && ' (dry)' || '' }}

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '*/10 * * * *'   # short ticks — the engine idles when busy
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      dryRun:
        description: 'Log the plan, perform no action'
        required: false
        type: boolean
        default: true

permissions:
  contents: write         # checkout + silent update-branch pushes
  issues: write           # labels + close-issue safety net
  pull-requests: write    # update-branch + merge
  checks: write           # bridge-free validation stamps
  actions: write          # workflow_dispatch on the teammate workflow

jobs:
  sm:
    # Pinned to the immutable SHA of IstiN/dmtools-agentic-workflows main
    # (the frozen machine-loop home; bump the SHA only together with the
    # matching loop change).
    uses: IstiN/dmtools-agentic-workflows/.github/workflows/factory-sm.yml@main
    with:
      # No .dmtools/config.js in this repo — the machine logins ride the
      # deployment-level input (#687, gh-728), exactly like the factory's
      # contract. Comma-separated LIST: the agent harness bot AND the CI
      # bot — github-actions[bot] authors its own PRs (live fa PR #1249)
      # and must ride the machine path (owner directive 2026-10-05).
      machine-author: 'ai-teammate,github-actions[bot],dmtools-factory-bot'
      # This repo dispatches no CI on PR heads (docs checks only) — the SM
      # leaves validation to the event-driven merge bot and labels.
      ci-workflow: ''
      # Manual ticks default to dry; cron ticks run live.
      dryRun: ${{ github.event.inputs.dryRun || 'false' }}
      # Factory-state snapshot → factory-data branch (board: site/factory,
      # third tab; fa machine-sm.yml parity — transport lives in
      # js/factoryState.js, publishing is opt-in per factory).
      state-publish: '{"channel":"release","tag":"factory-data","asset":"agents-state.json"}'
      # Silent branch updates: input channel (github.token via secrets/in
      # blocks arrives empty through a reusable call — live-verified).
      silent-token: ${{ github.token }}
    secrets:
      SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN }}
      # App auth (awf#52): minted installation token wins over the PAT
      # inside the factory when both secrets are present.
      APP_ID: ${{ secrets.APP_ID }}
      APP_PRIVATE_KEY: ${{ secrets.APP_PRIVATE_KEY }}
      SILENT_GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.SILENT_GH_TOKEN }}

      - name: Checkout dmtools-agents (rule engine + agent configs)

        with:
          repository: IstiN/dmtools-agents
          ref: ${{ env.DMTOOLS_AGENTS_REF }}
          path: dmtools-agents

      - name: Install dmtools CLI (pinned release)
        run: sh dmtools-agents/setup/install.sh
        env:
          DMTOOLS_VERSION: ${{ env.DMTOOLS_VERSION }}

      - name: Reconcile the machine loop
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          GH_REPO: ${{ github.repository }}
          DRY_RUN_INPUT: ${{ github.event.inputs.dryRun }}
        run: |
          # sm_github.json defaults point at the sm repo; the target repo
          # override rides the standard CLI JSON deep-merge.
          override="{\"params\":{\"jobParams\":{\"repo\":\"$SM_REPO\""
          if [ "$DRY_RUN_INPUT" = "true" ]; then
            override="$override,\"dryRun\":true"
          fi
          override="$override}}"
          cd dmtools-agents && dmtools run "$SM_CONFIG" "$override"

# Machine SM — thin stub over the FROZEN machine loop
# (IstiN/dmtools-agentic-workflows, reusable).
#
# Same freeze contract as dmtools-dart's machine-sm.yml: the workflow is
# pinned to an immutable SHA; agent code and the dmtools CLI resolve from
# RELEASES at run time via this repo's variables:
#   vars.AGENTS_VERSION  — dmtools-agents release tag ('latest' default)
#   vars.DMTOOLS_VERSION — dmtools-dart CLI release tag ('latest' default)
# Bump a version = repo-settings edit, never a workflow edit.
# NO caller-side concurrency: the factory owns the `machine-sm` group.

name: 'Machine SM'

run-name: >-
  🧹 SM ${{
    github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && 'manual tick' ||
    format('tick {0}', github.event.schedule || '') }}${{
  github.event.inputs.dryRun == 'true' && ' (dry)' || '' }}

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '*/10 * * * *'   # short ticks — the engine idles when busy
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      dryRun:
        description: 'Log the plan, perform no action'
        required: false
        type: boolean
        default: true

permissions:
  contents: write         # checkout + silent update-branch pushes
  issues: write           # labels + close-issue safety net
  pull-requests: write    # update-branch + merge
  checks: write           # bridge-free validation stamps
  actions: write          # workflow_dispatch on the teammate workflow

jobs:
  sm:
    # Pinned to the immutable SHA of IstiN/dmtools-agentic-workflows main
    # (the frozen machine-loop home; bump the SHA only together with the
    # matching loop change).
    uses: IstiN/dmtools-agentic-workflows/.github/workflows/factory-sm.yml@main
    with:
      # No .dmtools/config.js in this repo — the machine logins ride the
      # deployment-level input (#687, gh-728), exactly like the factory's
      # contract. Comma-separated LIST: the agent harness bot AND the CI
      # bot — github-actions[bot] authors its own PRs (live fa PR #1249)
      # and must ride the machine path (owner directive 2026-10-05).
      machine-author: 'ai-teammate,github-actions[bot],dmtools-factory-bot'
      # This repo dispatches no CI on PR heads (docs checks only) — the SM
      # leaves validation to the event-driven merge bot and labels.
      ci-workflow: ''
      # Manual ticks default to dry; cron ticks run live.
      dryRun: ${{ github.event.inputs.dryRun || 'false' }}
      # Factory-state snapshot → factory-data branch (board: site/factory,
      # third tab; fa machine-sm.yml parity — transport lives in
      # js/factoryState.js, publishing is opt-in per factory).
      state-publish: '{"channel":"release","tag":"factory-data","asset":"agents-state.json"}'
      # Silent branch updates: input channel (github.token via secrets/in
      # blocks arrives empty through a reusable call — live-verified).
      silent-token: ${{ github.token }}
    secrets:
      SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN }}
      # App auth (awf#52): minted installation token wins over the PAT
      # inside the factory when both secrets are present.
      APP_ID: ${{ secrets.APP_ID }}
      APP_PRIVATE_KEY: ${{ secrets.APP_PRIVATE_KEY }}
      SILENT_GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.SILENT_GH_TOKEN }}

=== machine-sm.yml jobParams wiring ===
# Machine SM — thin stub over the FROZEN machine loop
# (IstiN/dmtools-agentic-workflows, reusable).
#
# Same freeze contract as dmtools-dart's machine-sm.yml: the workflow is
# pinned to an immutable SHA; agent code and the dmtools CLI resolve from
# RELEASES at run time via this repo's variables:
#   vars.AGENTS_VERSION  — dmtools-agents release tag ('latest' default)
#   vars.DMTOOLS_VERSION — dmtools-dart CLI release tag ('latest' default)
# Bump a version = repo-settings edit, never a workflow edit.
# NO caller-side concurrency: the factory owns the `machine-sm` group.

name: 'Machine SM'

run-name: >-
  🧹 SM ${{
    github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && 'manual tick' ||
    format('tick {0}', github.event.schedule || '') }}${{
  github.event.inputs.dryRun == 'true' && ' (dry)' || '' }}

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '*/10 * * * *'   # short ticks — the engine idles when busy
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      dryRun:
        description: 'Log the plan, perform no action'
        required: false
        type: boolean
        default: true

permissions:
  contents: write         # checkout + silent update-branch pushes
  issues: write           # labels + close-issue safety net
  pull-requests: write    # update-branch + merge
  checks: write           # bridge-free validation stamps
  actions: write          # workflow_dispatch on the teammate workflow

jobs:
  sm:
    # Pinned to the immutable SHA of IstiN/dmtools-agentic-workflows main
    # (the frozen machine-loop home; bump the SHA only together with the
    # matching loop change).
    uses: IstiN/dmtools-agentic-workflows/.github/workflows/factory-sm.yml@main
    with:
      # No .dmtools/config.js in this repo — the machine logins ride the
      # deployment-level input (#687, gh-728), exactly like the factory's
      # contract. Comma-separated LIST: the agent harness bot AND the CI
      # bot — github-actions[bot] authors its own PRs (live fa PR #1249)
      # and must ride the machine path (owner directive 2026-10-05).
      machine-author: 'ai-teammate,github-actions[bot],dmtools-factory-bot'
      # This repo dispatches no CI on PR heads (docs checks only) — the SM
      # leaves validation to the event-driven merge bot and labels.
      ci-workflow: ''
      # Manual ticks default to dry; cron ticks run live.
      dryRun: ${{ github.event.inputs.dryRun || 'false' }}
      # Factory-state snapshot → factory-data branch (board: site/factory,
      # third tab; fa machine-sm.yml parity — transport lives in
      # js/factoryState.js, publishing is opt-in per factory).
      state-publish: '{"channel":"release","tag":"factory-data","asset":"agents-state.json"}'
      # Silent branch updates: input channel (github.token via secrets/in
      # blocks arrives empty through a reusable call — live-verified).
      silent-token: ${{ github.token }}
    secrets:
      SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN }}
      # App auth (awf#52): minted installation token wins over the PAT
      # inside the factory when both secrets are present.
      APP_ID: ${{ secrets.APP_ID }}
      APP_PRIVATE_KEY: ${{ secrets.APP_PRIVATE_KEY }}

- name: Checkout target repository
        uses: actions/checkout@8ade135a41bc03ea155e62e844d188df1ea18608 # v4
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Checkout dmtools-agents (rule engine + agent configs)
        uses: actions/checkout@8ade135a41bc03ea155e62e844d188df1ea18608 # v4
        with:
          repository: IstiN/dmtools-agents
          ref: ${{ env.DMTOOLS_AGENTS_REF }}
          path: dmtools-agents

      - name: Install dmtools CLI (pinned release)
        run: sh dmtools-agents/setup/install.sh
        env:
          DMTOOLS_VERSION: ${{ env.DMTOOLS_VERSION }}

      - name: Reconcile the machine loop
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          GH_REPO: ${{ github.repository }}
          DRY_RUN_INPUT: ${{ github.event.inputs.dryRun }}
        run: |
          # sm_github.json defaults point at the sm repo; the target repo
          # override rides the standard CLI JSON deep-merge.
          override="{\"params\":{\"jobParams\":{\"repo\":\"$SM_REPO\""
          if [ "$DRY_RUN_INPUT" = "true" ]; then
            override="$override,\"dryRun\":true"
          fi
          override="$override}}"
          cd dmtools-agents && dmtools run "$SM_CONFIG" "$override"

# Bump a version = repo-settings edit, never a workflow edit.

run-name: >-

on:

    inputs:

permissions:

- name: Checkout target repository
        uses: actions/checkout@8ade135a41bc03ea155e62e844d188df1ea18608 # v4
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Checkout dmtools-agents (rule engine + agent configs)
        uses: actions/checkout@8ade135a41bc03ea155e62e844d188df1ea18608 # v4
        with:
          repository: IstiN/dmtools-agents
          ref: ${{ env.DMTOOLS_AGENTS_REF }}
          path: dmtools-agents

      - name: Install dmtools CLI (pinned release)
        run: sh dmtools-agents/setup/install.sh
        env:
          DMTOOLS_VERSION: ${{ env.DMTOOLS_VERSION }}

      - name: Reconcile the machine loop
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          GH_REPO: ${{ github.repository }}
          DRY_RUN_INPUT: ${{ github.event.inputs.dryRun }}
        run: |
          # sm_github.json defaults point at the sm repo; the target repo
          # override rides the standard CLI JSON deep-merge.
          override="{\"params\":{\"jobParams\":{\"repo\":\"$SM_REPO\""
          if [ "$DRY_RUN_INPUT" = "true" ]; then
            override="$override,\"dryRun\":true"
          fi
          override="$override}}"
          cd dmtools-agents && dmtools run "$SM_CONFIG" "$override"
